messages:
lena_support: FYI customer reports a weird billing mismatch — Console shows a $50 promo credit in the billing UI but their API usage is still being charged and some requests returned 402. Account org: org_0abc. Can someone triage?

mike_billing: Thanks — can you paste an example request ID or a small repro so I can look at the billing-side logs? Also need the billing_profile id for that org (from org settings).

lena_support: Repro + logs below. Customer did: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXX" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"test"}' and got HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required (json error: {"code":"insufficient_funds","message":"usage exceeds credits"}).
Console screenshot (redacted) shows: Promos: "$50 promo applied until 2026-12-31" and UI balance: $50. Billing API endpoint: GET /v1/billing/credits returns {"credit_balance":0}.

sofia_infra: Two quick hypotheses: 1) promo was ingested as org-level display metadata but not attached to the billing_profile used by the API key (project-level keys can be scoped to different billing profiles). 2) promo ingestion job succeeded but the ledger sync to the usage/balance service failed.

deploy-bot: promo-ingest job run: job_id=promo-ingest-20260318-09, status=SUCCESS, processed=1 records, applied_to_org=org_0abc (meta-only flag: false).

mike_billing: Ok. lena, can you confirm the API key used and whether it's a project or org key? Also run (internal) billing lookup: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" https://billing.internal/v1/profiles?org=org_0abc — return the profile IDs. If the promo is attached to a different profile, API usage will not see it.

lena_support: Confirmed with customer: they used a project-level key tied to project p-77, which lists billing_profile: bp-77x. The promo in Console was added at org-level and the UI shows on the org billing page, but listing of promos from billing API shows promo attached to bp-99z (different profile). So looks like mismatch.

sofia_infra: That matches hypothesis #1. UI surfaces org-level promotions by merging multiple sources (org promos + profile promos) for visibility. But actual runtime billing checks use the project's billing_profile id. If promo was mistakenly associated with the wrong profile, charges would continue. Two remediation paths: a) attach the promo to bp-77x (requires billing-infra approval/log write and ledger entry), or b) issue an ad-hoc refund/credit for the consumed tokens and schedule a fix.

mike_billing: Creating billing infra ticket now. Ticket: BIL-4281 — Investigate promo record promo_03z, current owner bp-99z, requested reassignment to bp-77x. Assigned to @mike_billing and @sofia_infra. Steps in ticket: verify promo validity window, replay ledger apply, and re-run balance sync. ETA initial triage 6h.

lena_support: Shared proposed rollback/mitigation with customer: temporary $25 goodwill credit to cover immediate overage while billing team fixes mapping. Customer accepted and asked for ETA. I told them ~6-8 hours for triage + re-sync and we'll follow up in-thread.

sofia_infra: For engineers: quick repro to confirm behavior locally: 
1) create two billing profiles with small test promo: bp-A (promo attached), bp-B (no promo)
2) create project with billing_profile=bp-B and call /v1/generate with project key -> expect billed
3) change project's billing_profile to bp-A and call again -> expect credit applied

Example internal check (use internal tokens):
```
# check promo mapping
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  https://billing.internal/v1/promos/promo_03z

# check profile mapping
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  https://billing.internal/v1/profiles/bp-77x
```

Please do not run promo reassign without the billing ticket.

mike_billing: Also note: there was a small race window during last week's promo bulk import where some promos were written with the org_id field but profile_id set to the previous default (bp-99z). We're adding a validation to the import job to ensure profile mapping is explicit. Added technical note to BIL-4281.

lena_support: Added a short changelog entry and the customer is ok with the temporary credit. I'll post an update once billing confirms reassign. :thumbsup:

mike_billing: Update: billing infra confirmed promo_03z is valid and will be reassigned to bp-77x; ledger replay scheduled. Expect noticeable balance update in the API within ~30-45 minutes after replay. I'll ping when done.

deploy-bot: billing-replay job started: job_id=billing-replay-1798766000, status=RUNNING

mike_billing: replay finished successfully. Verified GET /v1/billing/credits for bp-77x now returns {"credit_balance":50.00}. Customer tokens were refunded via the ledger entry. Closing BIL-4281 after audit.

lena_support: Notified customer, they confirmed they see credit in API and no further unexpected charges. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
